# rollercan reference-redrawn artwork

The applied final PNGs redraw legible printing from this exact product's official photographs. The original flat artwork was not available in the supplied product table. Font choice, minor spacing and registration remain approximate. Original product photos are not cropped into textures or distributed. The bitmap output is identified as `reference-redraw`, with source URLs and hashes in `sources.json`; it is not presented as an exact vector export.

Printing is projected onto explicit existing physical shell/package surfaces. `artwork:false` on both `Model` and `GroveModule` suppresses all panels. The physical shell, interfaces, component APIs and hidden hardware are unchanged. Four-wire Grove connection/pose/detach/disposal and relevant real control/motion smoke passed; the evidence is `stickers-smoke.json`. No browser, full regression, production-fit, hardware or electrical acceptance is claimed.

Final rasters retain applicable M5Stack artwork/trademark rights. Raw photos, drawing sources, scripts and conversion intermediates remain outside all repositories. The user's permission covers the final image assets.

The exact-SKU OLED-face photograph shows a continuous PWRCAN adhesive film across the native service openings; the existing fixed socket hardware remains beneath it. PORT.A and debug printing project onto the original solid face/seat surfaces, leaving the real debug mouth open. Standard and Lite artwork use their own SKU photographs. Fixed labels stay on fixed shells; any rotating top print follows its actual rotor plate. OLED pixels and cap/flexure geometry remain external/unchanged.
